responsibility: This header is the primary target configuration header for GCC’s MIPS backend. It defines ABI and ISA enums, processor tuning metadata, target macros, architectural feature predicates, machine_function state, calling-convention and frame-layout related constants, and many compile-time configuration rules that shape code generation, scheduling, PIC handling, EH encoding, and multilib defaults across the entire MIPS port.
same_name_distinction: Within the mips same-name group, this header supplies the shared compile-time interface and target configuration macros/types used by the backend, such as ABI/ISA definitions and machine_function state, rather than implementing behavior like mips.cc, specifying RTL insns like mips.md, or declaring options like mips.opt.
